pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Individual patches exhibit a highly irregular, stellate or leaf-like morphology with sharply defined, jagged edge gradients. The geometry is non-uniform, characterized by multiple acute projections and deep pixel-level indentations across the flank and rump.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: The light-toned negative space forms a continuous reticulated graph. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate. The pixel thickness of the pathways is relatively uniform, with moderate continuity observed across the visible dorsal and lateral surfaces.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: A dark, low-profile mane is visible along the dorsal neck line. It exhibits a low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette where the upper neck contour meets the background.

other_distinctive_markers: The tail switch is visible as a dark, thin, continuous vertical line extending from the posterior midline of the rump.
